packet.headline_seed: "Notepad++ for Mac" release is disavowed by the creator of the original
packet.description_seed: As its name implies, the venerable Notepad++ text editor began as a more capable version of the classic Windows Notepad, with features such as line numbering and syntax highlighting. It was created in 2003 by Don Ho, who continues to be its primary author and maintainer, and it has been a Windows-exclusive app throughout its existence (older Notepad++ versions support OSes as old as Windows 95; the current version officially supports everything going back to Windows 7). I'm not a devoted user of the app, but I was aware of its history, which is why I was surprised to see news of a "Notepad++ for Mac" port making the rounds last week , as though it were a port of the original available from the Notepad++ website. Apparently, this news surprised Ho as well, who claims that the Mac version and its author, Andrey Letov , are "using the Notepad++ trademark (the name) without permission." Read full article Comments

original_article.research:
[Lähde: Ars Technica]
As its name implies, the venerable Notepad++ text editor began as a more capable version of the classic Windows Notepad, with features such as line numbering and syntax highlighting. It was created in 2003 by Don Ho, who continues to be its primary author and maintainer, and it has been a Windows-exclusive app throughout its existence (older Notepad++ versions support OSes as old as Windows 95; the current version officially supports everything going back to Windows 7).

I’m not a devoted user of the app, but I was aware of its history, which is why I was surprised to see news of a “Notepad++ for Mac” port making the rounds last week, as though it were a port of the original available from the Notepad++ website.

Apparently, this news surprised Ho as well, who claims that the Mac version and its author, Andrey Letov, are “using the Notepad++ trademark (the name) without permission.”

“This is misleading, inappropriate, and frankly disrespectful to both the project and its users,” Ho wrote. “It has already fooled people—including tech media—into believing this is an official release. To be crystal clear: Notepad++ has never released a macOS version. Anyone claiming otherwise is simply riding on the Notepad++ name.”

Further communication between Ho and Letov can be found in a Notepad++ GitHub thread, where Ho said he had been contacted by Letov before the Notepad++ for Mac app had launched, but that he hadn’t had time to reply.

“The problem is that using the official name Notepad++ and its logo gives the impression that your project is an official macOS version maintained or endorsed by the Notepad++ team, which is not the case,” wrote Ho in an email to Letov that he reposted to GitHub. “This create [sic] confusion for users and exposes both you and the project to trademark issues.”

Letov responded two days later, saying he hadn’t meant to insinuate that Ho was involved with the Notepad++ for Mac project. But he did insist that his port “actually expands notepad++ brand to mac” and expressed hope that Ho would allow him to continue to use the name. Ho responded, again asking Letov to stop using the Notepad++ name and logo and to change the project’s URL so that users would not mistake the project for an official Notepad++ port and contact Ho looking for support.

“I will prep for the site and some naming changes,” wrote Letov. “Give me a couple of weeks. My intention was to expand your brand. I really hope that at some point in the future you change your 

---

[Lähde: MacRumors]
Notepad++ creator Don Ho said the macOS version of the popular Windows code editor is fake and using the Notepad++ trademark without permission.

The unofficial Notepad++ app for macOSIn a blog post, Ho said the macOS app is "not authorized, not endorsed, and not affiliated with" the official version of Notepad++ in any way, adding that it is "misleading, inappropriate, and frankly disrespectful to both the project and its users."

In coordination with Ho, the developer of the macOS port Andrey Letov said he will rebrand the Mac app and its corresponding website in the coming days:

In coordination with Don Ho, the creator of the original Notepad++, I'll be evolving the branding of the macOS version so it stands on its own while respecting its lineage. These updates, such as a new logo, a refined name, and likely a new domain will ship with version 1.0.6 in the coming days. Continuity for existing users is a priority, and I'll make the transition as seamless as I can. Thank you for your patience.

Notepad++ is a popular open-source text and code editor available on Windows, and many users have long hoped for a Mac version. It appears the unofficial port will live on for now, but with a new name and branding.

"To be crystal clear: Notepad++ has never released a macOS version," said Ho.

payload.title: Notepad++:n tekijä kiistää Mac-version olevan virallinen julkaisu
payload.summary: Notepad++-tekstieditorin alkuperäinen tekijä Don Ho sanoo, ettei verkossa huomiota saanut ”Notepad++ for Mac” ole virallinen Mac-versio. Hon mukaan nimi käyttää Notepad++-tavaramerkkiä ilman lupaa.
payload.content:
Notepad++-tekstieditorin alkuperäinen tekijä ja nykyinen pääylläpitäjä Don Ho on kiistänyt, että verkossa huomiota saanut ”Notepad++ for Mac” olisi alkuperäisen sovelluksen virallinen Mac-julkaisu. Hon mukaan Mac-version tekijä Andrey Letov käyttää Notepad++-nimeä ilman lupaa, mikä on herättänyt kysymyksiä ohjelman alkuperästä ja käyttäjille syntyvästä mielikuvasta.

## Windows-ohjelmasta tunnettu editori

Notepad++ on pitkään tunnettu Windows-käyttäjien tekstieditorina. Se luotiin vuonna 2003 klassisen Windowsin Muistion laajennetummaksi vaihtoehdoksi. Ohjelma toi peruskäyttöön ominaisuuksia, kuten rivinumerot ja syntaksin korostuksen, joista on hyötyä erityisesti ohjelmoijille ja teknisille käyttäjille.

Ohjelman historia on ollut tiiviisti sidoksissa Windowsiin. Lähdetietojen mukaan vanhemmat Notepad++-versiot tukevat käyttöjärjestelmiä aina Windows 95:een asti, ja nykyversion virallinen tuki ulottuu Windows 7:ään. Tämän vuoksi vaikutelma virallisesta Mac-porttauksesta on poikkeuksellinen: Notepad++ ei ole ollut alkuperäisenä sovelluksena macOS-ohjelma.

## Nimi aiheutti epäselvyyttä

Mac-version ympärillä syntynyt huomio näyttää liittyneen erityisesti siihen, että julkaisu käytti nimeä ”Notepad++ for Mac”. Nimi voi helposti antaa käyttäjille vaikutelman, että kyseessä olisi alkuperäisen projektin hyväksymä tai sen viralliselta verkkosivustolta saatava versio.

Don Ho on kuitenkin ilmoittanut, ettei näin ole. Hänen mukaansa Mac-version tekijä Andrey Letov käyttää Notepad++-tavaramerkkiä eli nimeä ilman lupaa. Saatavilla olevien tietojen perusteella kyse ei siis ole virallisesta Notepad++-julkaisusta, vaan erillisestä projektista, jonka nimi on alkuperäisen tekijän mukaan ongelmallinen.

## Käyttäjille olennainen ero

Tapaus muistuttaa siitä, että tunnettujen ohjelmistonimien ympärillä voi syntyä nopeasti sekaannuksia, jos epävirallinen sovellus käyttää vakiintunutta nimeä. Käyttäjien kannalta olennaista on tarkistaa, kuka ohjelman julkaisee ja onko se alkuperäisen kehittäjän hyväksymä. Tässä tapauksessa alkuperäisen Notepad++-projektin tekijä on nimenomaisesti irtisanoutunut Mac-version virallisuudesta.
